def zip_tuples(test_tup1, test_tup2):
    """Write a function to zip the two given tuples.

    Pairs each element of ``test_tup1`` with an element of
    ``test_tup2``, repeating ``test_tup2`` cyclically when it is
    shorter than ``test_tup1``. If ``test_tup2`` is longer, only
    its first ``len(test_tup1)`` elements are used, mirroring
    ``zip(test_tup1, itertools.cycle(test_tup2))``. Empty inputs
    result in an empty list.
    """
    if not test_tup1 or not test_tup2:
        return []
    second_len = len(test_tup2)
    return [
        (value, test_tup2[index % second_len])
        for index, value in enumerate(test_tup1)
    ]
